background: Close Brothers Group is a UK merchant banking group, funded by retail and corporate deposits and lending on motor finance, asset finance, invoice finance and property development.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, BBB on average, both on a negative outlook, after a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 17 Oct 2025. Capital is mixed against UK mid-sized banks: leverage of 12.9% is in the top quarter, but CET1 of 13.8% is just below the peer median. Liquidity is the clear strength, with LCR of 1012% and NSFR of 146% both in the top quarter. The weak spot is earnings: the items flagged on 30 Sep 2026 report a narrower loss for the year despite another £165m charge for the car finance compensation scheme, with cost cutting stepped up.
